flags.text: "Add inline citation badges to assistant answers, with hover and keyboard-focus previews." - Although #233 initially added badges, #244 removed that implementation during integration and deferred inline badges; #245 subsequently reintroduced them over sanitized Markdown. Presenting #233 as a separate addition in this integrated changelog misrepresents what survived.

"A ticket’s first actionable suggestion now appears as a button or agent picker" - The first actionable suggestion becomes the primary control, but only status changes use a button and assignments use an agent picker. Other actionable suggestions, such as comments, are routed through the comments tab; the facts do not establish that every first actionable suggestion appears as a button or picker.

"When you request a ticket change, the assistant may ask you to confirm it again or claim it succeeded without a successful result." - The live reproduction did not reproduce either field behavior in five turns. The PR added prompt rules to prevent these behaviors; it does not establish that they were still occurring before this change.
